spirit.title: Esprit de Corps
spirit.text: The team spirit in the IQAC is not to serve as a data center, but rather as a way to bring together administrators, teachers, students, support staff, and all other stakeholders, allowing each of them to contribute to the university’s overall improvement.
spirit.emphasis: not to serve as a data center

title: IQAC will
facilitate and contribute to
items: Ensure clarity and focus in institutional functioning towards quality enhancement.
Ensure internalization of the quality culture.
Ensure enhancement and coordination among institutional activities and institutionalize good practices.
Provide a sound basis for decision-making to improve institutional functioning.
Act as a dynamic system for quality changes in higher education institutions.
Build an organized methodology for documentation and internal communication.
